selection: Higher validation mAP50-95 among the two resolution runs, with mAP50 supporting selection. Confidence maximizes pooled class-aware F1 on the 0.05 to 0.95 step 0.05 grid; higher threshold breaks ties.
limitations: Threshold chosen on validation; validation scores optimistic.
Pooled F1 is dominated by unsealed class.
Custom confidence-ordered one-to-one matching is separate from Ultralytics macro AP.
Validation exports use multi-label NMS; later deployment predict mode may use different postprocessing.
Do not tune on final test results.
